passages.title: A map for the club
passages.text: Our school club made a map for new students. I drew the library, and my friend drew the garden. We put a star next to our classroom. On Friday, we shared the map with our teacher.

passages.title: A windy afternoon
passages.text: It was windy after school. I wanted to fly my kite, but the park was closed. My sister and I made a paper kite at home instead.

passages.title: A new shelf
passages.text: We asked the librarian if we could start a book exchange. She showed us an empty shelf by the door. Each of us brought one book. By Thursday, there were twenty books on the shelf.
